fields.label: Enable Mobile Attendance
fields.description: Employees of this company can use the mobile app when the site switch is on and their Employee boxes allow it.

fields.label: Require Photo
fields.description: A selfie and GPS are captured with every check-in. Employee photo boxes can override this per employee.

fields.label: Require GPS Workplace
fields.description: Check-ins must be inside an enabled Mobile Attendance Workplace of this company.

fields.label: Require Approved Device
fields.description: Online check-ins need a phone approved by HR. Offline uploads always need one.

fields.label: Allow Offline
fields.description: Employees with Offline Check In may save punches on the phone. The site Offline Sync switch must also be on.
Zero keeps photos. Count from upload; offline photos also remain for this interval after final HR review. Holds override cleanup.
fields.label: Keep Photo for Days

fields.description: Opt-in hourly cleanup. Retains punch records and evidence hashes. Does not remove backups or shared files.
fields.label: Enable Automatic Photo Cleanup
